description: Close 4 CLI gaps blocking IntelliJ IDEA plugin integration: stdout output, single-file scan, relative paths, severity mapping.
prerequisite: dart pub get && dart analyze && dart test
validation_gate: confirm A2: dart run bin/flutterguard.dart scan example --format json --stdout --no-color 2>/dev/null | python3 -c 'import sys,json; json.load(sys.stdin); print("VALID_JSON")'

confirm A1: dart run bin/flutterguard.dart scan example/lib/main.dart --format json --stdout --no-color 2>/dev/null | python3 -c 'import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); assert d["scanMode"]=="full"; print("SINGLE_FILE_OK")'

confirm A3: dart run bin/flutterguard.dart scan example --format json --stdout --no-color 2>/dev/null | python3 -c "import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); assert all('fileRelative' in i for i in d.get('issues',[])); print('RELATIVE_OK')"

steps.label: Add --stdout flag: JSON/SARIF to stdout, suppress table summary

lib/src/cli/cli_parsers.dart.spec: abbr:null, help:'Print structured output to stdout instead of writing report files', defaultsTo:false, negatable:false

lib/src/cli/scan_command.dart.target: extract --stdout from args, pass as writeStdout param to FlutterGuardScanner.scan()

lib/src/scanner.dart.old_signature_hint: Future<ScanResult> scan({..., required bool writeJson, required bool writeSarif, ...})
logic: IF writeStdout AND format=='table' → print error to stderr + exit 2 ('--stdout requires --format json or --format sarif')
IF writeStdout AND writeJson → print json string to stdout; SKIP File(...).writeAsStringSync()
IF writeStdout AND writeSarif → print sarif string to stdout; SKIP File(...).writeAsStringSync()
IF NOT writeStdout → existing behavior (write to reportDir/report.json or report.sarif)
NEVER print table summary to stdout when writeStdout is true

steps.verify: dart run bin/flutterguard.dart scan example --format json --stdout --no-color 2>/dev/null | python3 -c 'import sys,json; json.load(sys.stdin); print("PASS")' → PASS

steps.label: Support single .dart file path as scan target

lib/src/project_resolver.dart.target: ProjectResolver or a new static helper
spec: IF scanPath ends with '.dart' AND File(scanPath).existsSync():
IF no pubspec.yaml found → error('No pubspec.yaml found above file')

lib/src/scanner.dart.target: inside scan() after project resolution, before FileCollector
spec: skip FileCollector; use filtered includeFiles directly
still read allFiles for import graph resolution (unchanged)

steps.verify: dart run bin/flutterguard.dart scan example/lib/main.dart --format json --stdout --no-color → valid JSON, scanMode unchanged

steps.label: Add fileRelative field to JSON issue output

lib/src/report_generator.dart.target: ReportGenerator.generateJson() or the issue serialization helper

lib/src/static_issue.dart.spec: OPTIONAL: add fileRelative getter computed from file + projectPath. OR compute inline in report generator (preferred — keeps StaticIssue unchanged).

steps.verify: dart run bin/flutterguard.dart scan example --format json --stdout --no-color 2>/dev/null | python3 -c "import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); assert all('fileRelative' in i for i in d.get('issues',[]))"

steps.label: Document IDE severity mapping; optional ideSeverity in rules JSON

content_lines: | FlutterGuard severity | IDE inspection level | SARIF level |

steps.verify: grep -q 'IDE severity mapping' README.md && grep -q 'IDE severity mapping' doc/FLUTTERGUARD_SPEC.md

add: test/cli_test.dart: '--stdout with --format table exits with error' → exit 2, stderr contains 'requires'
test/cli_test.dart: '--stdout with --format json writes valid JSON to stdout' → parse stdout as JSON, check schemaVersion
test/cli_test.dart: 'single .dart file path scans only that file' → issues only reference that file
test/cli_test.dart: 'single .dart file without parent pubspec exits with error' → exit 2
test/cli_test.dart: 'JSON issue includes fileRelative field' → assert fileRelative exists and starts with 'lib/'
